gen-fs-chubbo-fs-gambetta: Soft marker-tip roundness, flat and friendly, runs through Chubbo without a single swelling stroke. And Gambetta moves with a gentle ebb and flow of weight, giving the pairing a bookish grace.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-epunda-slab: Marker-drawn and unshaded, Chubbo glides through every bend, while Epunda Slab brings dignified, tall rounded lowercase forms. Loose and inviting above, steadier and more formal in the text below.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Chubbo moves around each bend like a marker tip, crossbars matching the stems in thickness. And Noto Sans Buginese keeps things modern, with open letter mouths and short ascenders.
gen-fs-chubbo-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab reads precise and structured, its middle zone dominating each line. Chubbo's marker-traced strokes bring a casual welcome up top, so reading down the page moves from friendly to firm.
gen-fs-expose-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Tight and striking, Expose barely pauses between x-height and caps. Be Vietnam Pro slips in underneath with curves like bent steel rods and endings that never crowd each other.
gen-fs-expose-fs-familjen-grotesk: Compressed and striking, Expose barely stops to breathe. Familjen Grotesk loosens things up with lively bowls left open on one side and lowercase that stands tall, good when the text stays brief.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Noto Sans Old Persian breathes, its lofty lowercase full of space. Expose does its best work tightly packed, striking and refined, where this body font lets the white space in.
gen-fs-expose-gf-savate: Tight and striking, Expose squeezes its lowercase almost up to cap height. Savate is the open-jawed foil, its tall rounded o nearly matching a capital O, with sturdy hairlines and a light modulation.
gen-fs-gambarino-cabin: Cabin reads warm and clean, its letters like bent tubing with terminals left easy and open. But Gambarino brings the drama with heavy stems and hairline whiskers, while Cabin's constant stroke keeps things steady.
gen-fs-gambarino-fs-chillax: Gambarino hits hard, with heavy stems and hairlines that nearly vanish. Chillax then relaxes the read, a spaghetti-like line with no contrast at all, so text flows loose and casual.
